system.description:
Your magical training or alteration by magic gives you your powers.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.QD7BBCX8C7mnA1FJ]{Awareness}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.5GDEdsr0jrDmWApP]{Flight}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.UEiMFUmpNBwhY20J]{Presence}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fbddUiHTU2MMOSU6]{Teleportation}

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Psychic powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.EMJBMnY6a1Uic5Dw]{Modification Wave}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.D33j3h1LaPxepUbm]{Mystic Redirection}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.TT5qCwPkikkKY4nd]{Sever Link}
Additional Info

Gain an Information quality and assign a d10 to it.

Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
